verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that LocalAI automatically detects GPU capabilities and downloads a matching backend, and that it ships a CPU path. Nothing documents diagnostic output, logs or warnings that explain why GPU acceleration failed or that a CPU fallback happened. Auto-detection is an adjacent feature, not the diagnostic capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know why GPU acceleration failed and silently fell back to CPU through clear diagnostic output
